Nora: Quick check — SOC2 sprint milestone this week. We need owners for KMS rotation evidence + audit-log query proof for non-prod. Who's on deck? @Liam @Priya

Liam: I can take KMS rotation evidence for staging. Will attach runbook snippets and sample logs.

Priya: I'll do audit-log queries and sampling in non-prod, can you confirm the log retention window? :eyes:

sec-bot: Reminder: evidence must include timestamped key IDs, rotation events, and PR/approval links. Template: /evidence/template-v2.md

Liam: Cool, for KMS I have these actions: 1) export rotation_history from keystore (keystore-staging:/rotation/history/2026-03) 2) snapshot key metadata with `gcloud kms keys describe` 3) link to PR D-4921. Will post artifacts by EOD Thursday.

Priya: For logs I'll run: ```gcloud logging read 'logName="projects/redwood-nonprod/logs/audit" protoPayload.methodName="cloudkms.keys.update"' --limit 200 > kms-rotation-sample.json``` and then sample ~50 events. I'll stage results to s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026-03/rotation/ and include a CSV index.

ops-oncall: Quick flag — non-prod retention is 14d. For SOC2 we need prod or archived snapshots. Can we capture a prod snapshot export? @Nora

Nora: Yes — ops, please sandbag a prod snapshot export to the evidence bucket. Keep the export minimal (rotation events only), encrypt with envelope key. Steps: see /runbooks/rotation-export.md.

Priya: Ack — I'll wait for the prod snapshot. If we can't get prod, we'll include an evidence note explaining the retention gap + justification.

Liam: I'll prepare key metadata + rotation playbook excerpts and link PRs/approvals. @sec-bot can you validate the checklist once artifacts land?

sec-bot: Checklist run (preliminary): key ids present, rotation timestamps, approver IDs, PR links, logs attached, encryption-at-rest verified. Missing item: approver signature on 2026-03-11 rotation event (needs manual sign-off).

Nora: Assigning owners: Liam -> KMS metadata + runbook snippets (due Thu EOD). Priya -> log samples + index (pending prod snapshot). Ops-oncall -> prod snapshot export (ASAP). sec-bot -> final checklist validation after upload. Please add short comments in the evidence index when you upload (who/what/where). Thanks! :thumbsup:

Liam: Noted. I'll DM ops for the snapshot window to avoid peak traffic.

Priya: If ops can't do prod, I can attempt a cross-project archived query and annotate. Will update by EOD tomorrow.

ops-oncall: Putting a request in now — ETA for export 6-8 hours. Will post the presigned s3 path when ready.

Nora: Great — we'll reconvene async here. If anyone hits blockers, ping #eng-security-urgent.

sec-bot: Evidence folder recommended layout: /soc2/2026-03/rotation/{kms-metadata.json, rotation-logs.json, index.csv, runbook-snippet.md, approvals.pdf}

Liam: Upload plan confirmed.

Priya: Thanks — will watch for the presigned path and then run the query against the export.

ops-oncall: Uploaded presigned path: s3://redwood-evidence/ps/5495001234-prod-rotation-export.tar.gz (expires in 24h).

Nora: Received — Priya/Liam please validate and mark items done in the evidence index.

Priya: Validated sample, adding notes now. Approver signature still outstanding for one event — @Liam can you check with product?

Liam: I'll follow up and attach the approval email/PDF to approvals.pdf.

Nora: Thanks team — this looks on track. We'll close this thread once sec-bot confirms checklist complete.
